title: civ.one sound set manifest
description: What a set of sound says about itself in the library: the head a tileset descriptor has, and where its files are kept, with no descriptor body.

$schema.description: This schema, for an editor to check the manifest against.

schema.title: Manifest format
schema.description: The manifest format, 1: any other is refused.
schema.x-message: schema {value} cannot be read here, only schema 1.

id.title: Id
id.x-message: id must be a non-empty string.

name.title: Name
name.description: The set's name, as a player sees it.
name.x-message: name must be a non-empty string.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the set comes from: hosted, built into the site and fetched, or imported, read from the player's own copy of the game it comes from.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: The set's licence, shown on its entry in the library. An imported set has none of ours to show.
licence.x-message: licence must have a name and a url, and any attribution must be a non-empty string.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Where its files are kept: a file's key in the store is prefix + name + ext, such as ./sources/ASOUND.CVL.
storage.x-message: storage must have a prefix and an ext.

x-message.type: a manifest must be an object.
